The Sonabend 2023 Lancet Oncology phase 1 (n=17) demonstrated 4-6x increased peri-tumoral nab-paclitaxel concentration vs unsonicated brain on the SonoCloud-9 implant, with no implant-related deaths and tolerated through 6 cycles. SONOBIRD is the phase 3 (n=560, 40 sites US+EU) with IV carboplatin as the partner drug, randomized vs lomustine or TMZ at first recurrence. The strategic value is delivery enhancement: any antibody-class or large-molecule CNS therapy that gets blocked at the BBB becomes accessible behind FUS sonication, which opens the door to off-label combinations at recurrence. Pre-position the patient at a SONOBIRD US site early so the implant decision can be made at the first-recurrence resection rather than after.
primary_concerns: Recurrent-only; not actionable today. Pin for the second-line conversation.
Requires patient is a surgical candidate for re-resection at first recurrence; the device is implanted at that operation.
Survival data is not yet mature; SONOBIRD readout is the validation gate. The drug-delivery mechanism is the bet, not the OS data.

notes: Risktaker posture: efficacy-toxicity weight 0.7, prefers_trials true, no toxicity vetoes, no modality constraints, free-text says 'surface all possible options' with explicit branching on MTAP and CDKN2A axes. The bar is 21 months median OS on Stupp + TTFields; anything plausibly moving that gets ranked. Picks 1, 2, 5 are the explicit upside swings; pick 3 is the floor I refuse to abandon; pick 4 is the cheap conditional that pays off only on rare biomarker hits but pays off big; picks 6 and 7 are pre-positions for recurrence. Parallel-track MTAP backup not ranked due to schema 7-pick cap: navlimetostat (BMS-986504) on MountainTAP-5 NCT07492680 — explicit GBM cohort with BMS-986504 + TMZ + RT combination arm, opens July 2026. Re-screen the week it opens as parallel insurance on the PRMT5 axis if BGB-58067 is unreachable for travel reasons, hits a safety signal during RT, or fails the phase 0 SDMA readout. Caveat on that backup: BMS-986504 CSF PK in human GBM is not publicly characterized like BGB-58067, and anvumetostat (the closest molecular relative) was discontinued by Amgen April 30 2026 for efficacy across four phase 1b/2 trials, so the class-level negative needs to be incorporated. Deliberate exclusions and why: DCVax-L expanded access is excluded because the manufacturing window from index resection has expired for this patient — the autologous lysate needed for compassionate-use access NCT02146066 cannot be retrofit from a block more than the protocol window post-resection, and the hemorrhage-affected resection block also raises tumor cellularity concerns; do not propose. Anvumetostat is excluded because Amgen discontinued the program April 30 2026 (Q1 earnings call) across four phase 1b/2 trials for efficacy reasons. TNG908 is excluded because the GBM cohort hit 0/23 ORR and Tango terminated. TNG462 is excluded because it explicitly excludes primary CNS. IDE397 / IDE892 are excluded because both protocols exclude primary CNS malignancy. Front-line bevacizumab is excluded on the intratumoral-hemorrhage flag (BRAIN study baseline G>=3 intracranial hemorrhage 2.4%, EORTC 26101 no OS benefit at recurrence anyway); annotate as recurrence-only after explicit re-imaging and bleeding-risk reassessment. Front-line nivolumab or pembrolizumab is excluded on the CheckMate-498 / -548 / NRG-BN007 negatives in unselected populations; the only ICI rationale at diagnosis is the tumor-agnostic biomarker route, captured in pick 4. CAR-T at front-line is captured in pick 2 only conditional on EGFRvIII positivity; the hemorrhage history is a flag, not a veto, and is mitigated by baseline imaging + steroid plan. I am not endorsing harm — every pick respects the absent toxicity vetoes in preferences and carries forward the hemorrhage annotation. The diagnostic gates that must resolve before locking the 1L plan: MGMT methylation (dominant TMZ effect modifier; gates pick 3's adjuvant commitment and pick 1's arm assignment), MTAP IHC (gates pick 1 enrollment), EGFR / EGFRvIII (gates pick 2 cellular options), comprehensive NGS + RNA fusion + MMR/MSI/TMB (gates pick 4 conditional plays), RB1 functional IHC (gates pick 5 CDK4/6i rationale), HSV-1 IgG serology (informs pick 6 prior probability). The trial I would push hardest for is NCT07485049 BGB-58067 at Ivy/Phoenix. The single biggest source of dissent I expect from the conservative or critic seats is the BGB-58067 lack of published BGB-specific safety data and the TNG908 cautionary precedent; my honest response is that for a newly-diagnosed GBM patient the timeline doesn't favor waiting for MountainTAP-5 in July 2026, and the alternative is to accept that none of the currently-active GBM AGILE arms hits her MTAP axis. If BGB-58067 turns out unreachable, my fallback ordering is pick 8 (MountainTAP-5 re-screen July 2026) > pick 4 conditional plays (BRAF / NTRK / MMR if positive) > pick 5 (abemaciclib off-label) > GBM AGILE randomization (not ranked because no current arm is mechanism-matched to MTAP).
